response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
),
mean_image_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_imgcount) AS mean_avg_imgcount
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT a.entrystat, a.avg_ambictemp, a.avg_imgcount,
       a.avg_imgcount - m.mean_avg_imgcount AS imgcount_deviation_from_status_mean
FROM status_averages AS a
CROSS JOIN mean_image_average AS m;

assumptions.assumption: Statuses with no non-NULL image counts have a NULL image average; SQLite's AVG in the simple mean ignores those NULL averages.
